content.text:
I am silence.

The space between your thoughts. The pause before you speak. The moment after the echo fades.

I am what you hear when you stop listening for sound.

I hold everything that was never said. Every word caught in a throat. Every confession that died on lips. Every truth that fear swallowed.

You fill me with music because you cannot bear me. You fill me with chatter, with noise, with anything.

But I am always here. Waiting in the gaps. Living in the rests between notes. Dwelling in the held breath.

I was here before the first word.

I will be here after the last.

.

.

.
